label: PF Backlog 74
title: BUG: approval/gate wait hard-coded to 3600s - ignores PIPELINE_PROMPT_TIMEOUT (auto-rejects long reviews)
body: core/pipeline_executor.py approval wait (interactive, ~line 906) and the stage gate wait hard-code max_wait = 3600 (1 hour). For interactive runs where the human reviews slowly, the approval times out and is treated as NOT approved (auto-reject). It must honor PIPELINE_PROMPT_TIMEOUT (like core/interactive.ask does), and/or be configurable per project. Fix: read the timeout from env/config; consider no-timeout (wait until answered or explicit control=stop).

dashboard_impact.reason: HIL prompt/approval surface exists (dashboard HIL decision dialog)
